deals.summary: A group led by Fortress co-founder Wes Edens and Avenue Capital co-founder Marc Lasry bought the Bucks from Herb Kohl for $550M, then a record for an NBA control transaction.

deals.investor: Haslam Sports Group (Jimmy and Dee Haslam)
deals.summary: Haslam Sports Group closed on Lasry's stake (about 25%) at a roughly $3.2bn valuation after NBA owner approval; the February agreement had been reported at $3.5bn.

ownership_summary: A group led by Wes Edens (Fortress Investment Group co-founder, the NBA-listed governor) has controlled the Bucks since buying the team from Herb Kohl in 2014 for $550M with Marc Lasry. Jimmy and Dee Haslam (Haslam Sports Group) bought Lasry's roughly 25% in April 2023 at a ~$3.2bn valuation; Junior Bridgeman agreed to buy 10% in September 2024 at a $3.4bn valuation from small limited partners.

stadium_owner.detail: Forbes lists the Wisconsin Center District (a public district) as owner of Fiserv Forum, opened 2018 at a cost of $524M.
